findings.title: La visionneuse rejette un voisin SQL correct quand deux horodatages distincts tombent dans la même milliseconde
findings.discoveredDuring: Independent review of server/media/store.mjs six-decimal gallery cursor fix against f2d320d
reproduction: OlderSQL2026-10-1512:00:01.123300 has messageIdff…ff; newerSQL2026-10-1512:00:01.123456 has messageId00…01.
Fornext, compared=0||(-1), so guard rejects the valid newer result. Forprevious the inverse valid result is likewise rejected.
findings.scope: Historical or imported DATETIME(6) values containing sub-millisecond differences with IDs ordered opposite to true dates. Not a demonstrated issue for every ordinary new message.
findings.suggestedKissFix: Do not infer SQL six-decimal chronology from millisecond DTOs; preserve ownership/URL/shape guards and strict direction when distinguishable; use authorized endpoint ordering when equal-ms, rejecting identical message. Add browser regression on reversed IDs/equal-ms and qualify exact new source.
